source.initial_environment: the same two-mode vacuum within each trial; a fresh vacuum between independent trials
source.detector: one shared symmetric visibility eta for each terminal binary observable; the terminal record itself is read without error
physical_inputs: independent stationary trials within each setting

calibration.confidence_rule: simultaneous Hoeffding intervals for two Bernoulli plus probabilities; radius sqrt(log(4/alpha)/(2N)); transform to expectations and intersect the declared joint physical model
calibration.nominal_rule: use calibration only; choose the midpoint of the feasible lambda projection, then the midpoint of the feasible eta section; round lambda and eta to 12 decimal places and verify feasibility

holdout.input: Bell SR; R untouched until terminal readout
holdout.record_outcomes: for each record in the stated order, binary outcomes - then +; all eight cells retained

families.purpose: separately declared time-order holdout; same total duration and instrument/rotation sequence
generator changes detector visibility outside the frozen shared-detector domain; estimator and classifier cannot read truth

holdout.confidence_rule: simultaneous Hoeffding intervals for 96 (3 families x 4 settings x 8 cells) event probabilities; compare to all predictions permitted by the calibration confidence set, using a rigorous covering error
holdout.no_feedback_rule: calibration confidence set, nominal parameters, model grid and test rule frozen and hashed before any holdout sampling

error_certificate.distance: half trace norm over complete terminal CQ output on SR
error_certificate.numerical_roundoff: must have an independently supplied enclosure; never set to zero because two floats agree
error_certificate.readout_visibility_addition: max_eta_deviation/2 for each fixed complete binary terminal tester

comparison.strong_baseline: standard persistent joint evolution and standard Gaussian influence functional with the identical calibration confidence set, controls and robust error rule
comparison.independent_numerical_backend: Galerkin evolution of the same Hamiltonian, cutoff 20, checked against Weyl history pairs
comparison.gain_rule: identical conditional maps and inference rule imply EQUIVALENT_NO_ADDED_GAIN; a negative-control win is not a strong-baseline gain
